text:
alex: thinking about a small ergonomics win — a "pinless" rollout helper for quick hotfixes. keep it gated but avoid pin churn

marta: curious, what's pinless mean here? fallbacks?

alex: yeah — deploy-bot can accept a --transient flag that doesn't change canonical pin state. useful for 1-off patch deploys during change windows. falls back to pinned model if transient fails.

nick: ooh. so we avoid a formal pin + revert dance. how do we record it in release notes?

alex: auto-annotate the release note with "transient rollout" and include rollback hook. minimal human steps.

sam: show me the command snippet you imagined

alex: ```
# transient deploy, 10% roll, 30m window, auto-rollback on error
deploy-bot rollout --model v1.3.2 --percent 10 --window 30m --transient --on-error rollback
```

marta: love the syntax. can we add a dry-run that summarizes routing impact and cost delta?

alex: yes, dry-run -> produces a short table: expected p50/p95 + estimated token cost delta + KV cache hit projection. output is human readable and machine-parseable (json).

ops-bot: reminder — change-window still required for >20% traffic. transient flag only for <=20% and <=2 hour windows. :information_source:

nick: what about audit trail? we need clear trace in console + event log so CS/infosec can see transient rollouts.

alex: plan: push an "annotate:transient" event to the private audit stream, plus a pinned note in the release doc. ops-bot will add a message with timestamps.

sam: and rollback ergonomics? I want a single command to unwind transient and snapshot any artifacts.

alex: ```
# rollback transient rollout and snapshot rollout notes
deploy-bot rollback --transient-id 2026-03-19-0915 --snapshot-notes true
```

marta: how do we get the transient-id? deploy-bot returns it in the dry-run and in the rollout response. short alphanumeric.

nick: can the bot also generate a thin release brief (one-paragraph) to paste into channel? saves ops time.

alex: yes — JSON field brief and a one-line summary. example: "transient rollout 0x7f4d: v1.3.2 -> 10%, p95 target ok, auto-rollback in 30m"

ops-bot: suggested safety: if any canary trace shows an error spike >3x baseline, immediate rollback. also optionally notify #incidents.

sam: okay, templates needed: preflight dry-run, brief, rollback snippet, and a short checklist for on-call. I can sketch them.

marta: add a step to sanity-check cache-warm on 0 traffic to avoid missed cold-start regressions.

alex: adding a new small "botlet" subcommand set — deploy-bot micro commands for quick ops: 
```
# preview
deploy-bot botlet preview --model v1.3.2 --percent 5 --dry-run

# apply transient
deploy-bot botlet apply --model v1.3.2 --percent 5 --transient --window 30m

# rollback transient
deploy-bot botlet revert --id 0x7f4d
```

nick: can we store templates in a repo under release-templates/ so SREs can tweak? YAML frontmatter + simple placeholders?

sam: yes, and the bot should accept a --template arg to run from template.

alex: next steps: sam to draft templates, nick to add audit event shape, marta to sketch dry-run outputs. I'll prototype botlet CLI and wire auto-annotate. target: a small alpha for next week's release window. :shipit:

marta: i'll add a short blurb to the release notes template so transient rollouts are visible to PM/CS.

ops-bot: scheduled change-window check: please don't use --transient during blackout (03:00-05:00 UTC). automated guard in place.

nick: cool — will put the templates as PRs and link to the alpha run thread.

sam: thanks. if it helps, i'll make a one-click playground script to run a simulated dry-run (no infra).

alex: perfect. low-friction but auditable. this should reduce pin churn and speed small hotfixes while keeping rollback hygiene.

deploy-bot: deployment accepted. id=0x7f4d. dry-run summary: p50 +2ms, p95 +15ms, estimated +$0.04/10k tokens.

marta: nice, let's try it in staging tomorrow.

nick: marking follow-ups: PRs for templates, audit schema, botlet prototype. assigning owners in the tracker.

sam: 👍

alex: closing for now, will open the alpha deploy thread when prototype ready.
